name: 84004 · Alpine, UT
findings: ZIP 84004 (Alpine) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84004 (Alpine) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 84004 (Alpine) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
